reports.desc: Hi, this is Ryan from CBC. A recent investigation uncovered credit card companies and major banks have violated consumer protection laws such as the Fair Credit Billing Act and Fair Credit Reporting Act. Because of this, these businesses are not allowed to collect on their accounts, meaning you are no longer legally required to pay back certain debt. And those balances will also be removed from your credit report. To hear which banks and credit card companies were found guilty and what will be removed from your credit, call 888-356-1808. Again, that's 888-356-1808.

Someone from Fletcher & Associates Mediation Group called me and tried to collect a debt that was not owed.  I did not incur this debt.  It was a scam. The person stated that they had my personal information, and would take legal action, including wage garnishment and file a lawsuit.
I got a letter saying my home warranty was expiring. It used urgent language.

United Covenant Financial repeatedly calls your number using an auto-dialer, leaving voice-mail messages that are cut off mid-sentence (indicating the auto-dialer). Their representatives are argumentative and although they claim to put you on the 'Do Not Call' list, fail to explain that any interaction with any of their fraudulent phone numbers immediately removes you from the 'Do Not Call' list and registers you as interested in a loan. Their practices are scummy, at best.

Litegic- sent me Job information I applied got the job. Was informed there was a 30 day probation period starting July 3th - Aug 3rd (Aug 3rd Payday). Company shipped products to my home upon receipt of products I inspected and repacked then shipped to the customer provide via the Label Litegic provided. Once end of probation was hear. I was informed that I would receive $3,300 + $100.00 transports, and reimbursement for materials I paid for out of pocket. Received a email that check was mailed on Aug 3rd at it would take 10 to 14 business days to receive. I has now been over 45days and I have received nothing. I have email all parties involved as well as called the two numbers provided to receive no answer from anyone. I have left 2 voice message as well as multiple emails with no reply from anyone.
This job really put me in a bind due to looking for more work to help with my financial situation.

Letter from law firm (using a name similar to a legitimate law firm) that said we were possible claimants to proceeds from unclaimed “permanent life insurance policy”. 10% of funds would go to various charities and remaining 90% would be split 50/50 between law firm and us. For additional info letter said to contact howard@howardgliblaw.com with a copy to howard.glib.law@gmail.com.
Letter was postmarked Houston, Texas Aug 28, 2026 RPDC 773 with a regular postage stamp.
I ordered product by mistake on order # 159376. Tried reach out to vender half an hour later to get a refund woth no response.
I applied for a credit card through reserve and was denied but paid the full fee and was told I would get my money back but it’s been a month and I haven’t received my money
Fraudulent charge on credit card, i never purchased from this site or business. Am disputing this charge with my CC company.

I bought incontinence underwear from titanboxers.com . when they arrived they were too tight and didn't feel as if they had the extra padding. i called them  and  told them was sent the wrong product, and was told it would be 24 hours before i would hear back. i never heard back. This started a chain of e mails, with them telling me because of them importing their product from china, full refunds are not possible, at current date the largest return i have been offered is 40% . the web site said a 100% refund, no questions asked

Pressure tactics used to scam an elderly couple for a garage door service that was never repaired. He had them sign documents saying that they could not dispute the claim with the credit card company.
The scammer claimed that the mark for my business was currently marked as abandoned. The scammer then claimed that a third party is interested in registering it.
